table_s5.description: Filtered singlet Perturb-seq barcodes with guide, target, library, RNA-velocity trajectory, QC counts, protospacer and batch

curation_decisions.obs_authority: Table S5 is the exact accepted-cell authority; its barcode order equals GEO barcodes, X.obs_names and current original_obs_index.
curation_decisions.controls: Guide target Non-Targeting plus Library Control defines strict non-targeting controls; Table S5 supplies protospacers for every accepted row.
curation_decisions.timepoint: D8 is materialized as 11520 minutes from initiation of neural induction.
curation_decisions.cell_state: RNA velocity trajectory is preserved as trajectory_id; it is not relabeled as a cell ontology identity.
curation_decisions.var_authority: The author-commit unified_metadata feature_id axis is exact and source-native after the documented Cell Ranger underscore-to-hyphen sanitization affecting 29 IDs. Its gene_id is used only when unambiguous; no Ensembl ID is fabricated for custom LH features.
curation_decisions.strict_var_boundary: The canonical VAR remediation metric is complete only as a source-bound identity/species/disposition contract: 44025 standard genes have exact source-backed ENSG IDs, 16401 source-native custom LH features are exact-ENSG not_applicable, and 71 unresolved applicable features remain unknown. Full-feature Ensembl coverage is separately false; no identifier is fabricated.

forbidden_inferences: Do not infer perturbation target from guide-string parsing when Table S5 supplies it.
Do not coerce source-native LH identifiers to Ensembl IDs.
Do not treat RNA-velocity trajectory categories as measured pseudotime.

Do not claim full-feature Ensembl coverage for features without a unique source-backed Ensembl stable gene ID; VAR_ENSEMBL_SPECIES_COMPLETED denotes exact source identity, human species, and an explicit known/not_applicable/unknown Ensembl disposition for every row.
